question: What causes the diverse embodied forms to appear distinctly in that domain?
premises: Various forms, including womb-born and others, appear there.
These forms shine separately from one another.
Their distinct appearance occurs by the will of the Lord.
inference: The differentiation of embodied forms is grounded in the Lord’s will.
uncertainties: The full range of birth-types implied by jarāyu+maulayās is not enumerated.
plain_english: There the various forms, such as those born from the womb and others, shine forth separately by the will of the Lord.
